messages:
alex: Heads up — want to prototype a Grafana panel to detect thermal anomalies across the GPU fleet and correlate with recent billing spikes. Looking for something lightweight we can ship to prod for a week. Anyone available to pair on PromQL and panel layout?

priya: I can jump in this afternoon. What source metrics do we want to include? NVML temps, PDU inlet, power draw, GPU util?

tom: +1. Also suggest derived metrics: 5m temp delta vs 95p baseline per node, and a rolling duty-cycle metric (active_time / wall_time). That helps ignore short bursts.

alex: Exactly. Panel idea: top row — rack heatmap (95p temp by rack), middle — per-node timeseries with temp & power overlaid, bottom — scatter/heatmap of duty-cycle vs temp with point size = avg power. Alert: temp_delta > 8C sustained 15m AND power_draw up > 20% for same window.

maria: Sharing some PromQL snippets I prototyped earlier:
```
# 5m avg temp per GPU
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius{job="nvml-exporter"}[5m])

# 95th percentile per rack (label rack=)
quantile_over_time(0.95, avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius{job="nvml-exporter"}[5m])) by (rack)

# power draw normalized per GPU model
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_power_draw_watts{job="nvml-exporter"}[5m]) / on(gpu_model) group_left(gpu_tdp_watts) gpu_tdp_watts
```

kevin: Caveat: some tenants use fractional GPUs via MIG/sharing. We should normalize power and util by gpu_instance count label (migs). Also ensure label cardinality stays low (use rack/node/model).

priya: For alert rule proto:
```
# temp delta = now - baseline_95p
(temp_now - baseline_95p) > 8 and increase(power_now, 15m) / baseline_power > 0.2
```
We can implement baseline_95p as a recording rule referencing 30d quantile by rack.

alex: Nice. Can someone wire the panel scaffold in the Grafana folder? Pref name: "GPU Fleet — Thermal Anomaly (pilot)". Keep it in Ops / Fleet dashboards so SRE can access.

grafana-bot: New panel draft created: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops-fleet/gpu-fleet-thermal-anomaly?orgId=1&panelId=987 (panel draft id: 987)

maria: I moved a draft JSON to the dashboards repo (branch: infra/gpu-thermal-anomaly). It includes queries and a mock heatmap. Needs axis tuning and color thresholds.

kevin: For thresholds, prefer dynamic thresholds based on model TDP: color map steps = [baseline+3C, baseline+6C, baseline+10C]. Static thresholds lead to noise across A100 vs 40C cards.

tom: Also add an internal-only toggle to switch to per-tenant view (labels: tenant_id). That will help correlate with billing spikes.

alex: Solid. Priya, can you own the alert runbook? Include links to node logs, nvml exporter logs, PDU telemetry, and a quick mitigation checklist (remote reboot, schedule maintenance, tenant throttling).

priya: On it — will add a runbook stub and add a contact list for oncall.

alex: Great. Next steps: Priya + Tom to refine PromQL and recording rules; Maria to clean up panel visuals and PR; Kevin to advise on normalization. I'll schedule a 30m pairing tomorrow 11:00am PT. :thumbsup:

priya: Sounds good. I'll post the PR link here when ready.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/dashboards/pull/142 (draft) — comments welcome.

kevin: Quick thought — we should add a small nightly job to re-evaluate baseline windows to avoid seasonal drift.

alex: Agree. Add that to the runbook ops checklist. Thanks everyone.

grafana-bot: Reminder: dashboard draft will auto-expire in 7 days if not promoted.

priya: noted — we'll promote after a short pilot.
